Each task appears as a row with its status and priority indicators. The list shows loading, empty and error states, and it refreshes after a task changes.","business_value":"The user can check the state and priority of all tasks in one place without opening each task.","acceptance_criteria":[{"given":"A task list that contains at least one task","when":"The to-do management page is opened and the read-all request succeeds","then":"The task list view shows the list","when":"The task list view is displayed","then":"Each task shows a status indicator whose text is exactly Open, In Progress or Completed"},{"given":"A task with priority Low, a task with priority Medium and a task with priority High in the list","when":"The task list view is displayed","then":"Each task shows a priority indicator whose text is exactly Low, Medium or High"},{"given":"The backend read-all request has not yet returned","when":"The task list view is opened","then":"A loading state is shown and no task rows and no empty message are loading and empty states, and no previously loaded task rows are shown as current"},{"given":"The task list view is showing tasks","when":"The user creates, edits, deletes or changes the status of a task and the backend confirms the change","then":"The task list is re-fetched from the backend and the rows reflect the saved change without a manual page reload"},{"given":"A task ID that exists in
